name: Superior Grimoire
desc: A grimoire with immense wind power trapped within its pages. Opening the cover unleashes its full force, but it's so strong that gales of wind can be seen circling the book even while it's still closed.

eff.name: Magic Gale
eff.desc1: Deals [150 + (Lv. x 30)] power air damage. Consumes half of your environmental mana and increases damage in proportion to the amount consumed.
eff.desc2: Deals [150 + (Lv. x 30)] power air damage. Increases the amount of environmental mana acquired by [Lv. x 1]% when gauge is at 50% or lower.

eff.name: Binding Page
eff.desc1: Grants a [Lv. x 10]% chance to inflict 1 stack(s) of Daze on the target.
eff.desc2: Reduces cooldowns by [Lv. x 5]% when you defeat an enemy.

eff.name: Conduction Magic
eff.desc1: Has a [Lv. x 10]% chance to apply 3 random negative effect(s) to the target.
eff.desc2: Increases damage by [Lv. x 5]% if the target's HP is at 50% or lower.
